filter_syntax: filter 为条件表达式字符串，支持以下写法：比较 == != > >= < <=；组合 and/or 与括号；文本包含 field.contains('文本')（单个文本字面量，大小写敏感）；集合 field in [...] / field not in [...]，列表也可用 rN.column 或 stepN.column；空值 field is None / field is not None。字段取自当前方法，值使用带引号的文本、数字、True/False 或 None。

report_query.desc: 查询逐篇研报的评级、目标价、观点、风险和来源。
report_query.call_pattern: r{id} = stock.report.query(filter, order, limit) -> field1, field2
report_query.output_rule: 每行一篇研报；输出当前研报字段。

report_aggregate.desc: 聚合研报数量、评级或目标价，支持按公司统计。
report_aggregate.call_pattern: r{id} = stock.report.agg(filter, agg, group_by, order, limit) -> group_fields, aggregate_expression as alias
report_aggregate.output_rule: 输出 group_by 字段和一个聚合表达式 as 别名；省略 group_by 时返回整体统计。
rules: agg 使用 method(field)，字段与方法从当前 aggregate_fields 选择；每次调用计算一个聚合目标。
filter 筛选研报行，group_by 分组，order/limit 作用于聚合结果；统计单位为每条匹配研报记录。

report_metric_query.desc: 查询逐机构、逐公司、逐年度的研报标准指标事实。
report_metric_query.call_pattern: r{id} = stock.report_metric.query(filter, order, limit) -> field1, field2
report_metric_query.output_rule: 每行一个研报指标事实；输出当前指标字段。

report_metric_aggregate.desc: 聚合研报标准指标事实，支持按公司、机构或年度统计。
report_metric_aggregate.call_pattern: r{id} = stock.report_metric.agg(filter, agg, group_by, order, limit) -> group_fields, aggregate_expression as alias
report_metric_aggregate.output_rule: 输出 group_by 字段和一个聚合表达式 as 别名；省略 group_by 时返回整体统计。
rules: agg 使用 method(field)，字段与方法从当前 aggregate_fields 选择；每次调用计算一个聚合目标。
filter 筛选指标事实，group_by 分组，order/limit 作用于聚合结果。
聚合 metric_value 时筛选单一 metric_code，或将 metric_code 纳入 group_by。

_meta.desc: 股票研报及研报预测指标。

report.desc: 逐篇机构研报的评级与变动、目标价、核心观点、风险和来源；核心观点提供增长催化、业绩驱动、竞争格局与市场份额、竞争优势及战略展望的分析依据。

investment_highlights.desc: 机构投资逻辑与判断依据，包括增长催化、竞争优势和经营展望。

api.api_function: 查询逐篇研报的评级、目标价、核心观点、风险与来源；investment_highlights 提供机构判断的理由与催化因素。
guidance: limit=-1 返回全部匹配研报，受安全上限保护，超限返回错误。
examples: r1 = stock.report.query(filter = "(code == '300750.SZ') and (report_date >= '2026-01-01') and (report_date <= '2026-07-28')", order = "report_date desc", limit = 10) -> code, name, report_date, institution, rating, investment_highlights, risk_warnings

r2 = stock.report.query(filter = "(code in r1.code) and (report_date >= '2025-01-01')", order = "report_date desc", limit = 20) -> report_id, code, name, title, report_date, institution, analysts, rating, target_price_lower, target_price_upper

api.api_function: 统计匹配研报的数量、日期或目标价，支持按公司、机构及评级分组。
examples: r1 = stock.report.agg(filter = "report_date >= '2026-01-01'", agg = count(stock.report.report_id), group_by = "code, name, rating", order = "report_count desc", limit = 50) -> code, name, rating, count(stock.report.report_id) as report_count

r2 = stock.report.agg(filter = "(code == '300750.SZ') and (report_date >= '2025-01-01')", agg = median(stock.report.target_price_upper)) -> median(stock.report.target_price_upper) as median_target_price_upper

rules: report_date 为研报发布日期，按自然日期选择范围。
目标价数值字段返回可解析数值，原文由 target_price_lower_raw/target_price_upper_raw 提供。

report_metric.desc: 研报标准年度指标事实，按公司、机构、年份和值类型查询 EPS、归母净利润及增速、营业收入及增速、PE、PB、ROE。

api.api_function: 查询逐机构、逐公司、逐年度的原始指标值，供明细对比与排序。
guidance: limit=-1 返回全部匹配指标事实，受安全上限保护，超限返回错误。
examples: r1 = stock.report_metric.query(filter = "(code == '300750.SZ') and (metric_code == 'eps') and (value_type == 'forecast') and (forecast_year >= 2026)", order = "forecast_year asc, report_date desc", limit = 50) -> report_id, code, name, report_date, institution, metric_code, metric_name, forecast_year, metric_value, unit, source_locator

r2 = stock.report_metric.query(filter = "(institution == '中金公司') and (name == '海尔智家') and (metric_code == 'np_parent') and (forecast_year == 2027) and (value_type == 'forecast')", order = "report_date desc", limit = 10) -> report_id, code, name, institution, report_date, forecast_year, metric_value, unit, reliable, source_locator

api.api_function: 统计匹配研报指标事实，支持按公司、机构及年度分组。
examples: r1 = stock.report_metric.agg(filter = "(metric_code == 'eps') and (value_type == 'forecast') and (forecast_year >= 2026) and (report_date >= '2025-01-01')", agg = avg(stock.report_metric.metric_value), group_by = "code, name, forecast_year, metric_code, unit", order = "avg_eps desc", limit = 50) -> code, name, forecast_year, metric_code, unit, avg(stock.report_metric.metric_value) as avg_eps

r2 = stock.report_metric.agg(filter = "(code == '300750.SZ') and (metric_code == 'revenue') and (value_type == 'forecast')", agg = median(stock.report_metric.metric_value), group_by = "forecast_year, metric_code, unit", order = "forecast_year asc") -> forecast_year, metric_code, unit, median(stock.report_metric.metric_value) as median_revenue

rules: metric_code 与 value_type 从 value_domains 选择；forecast_year 为指标年度，report_date 为研报发布日期。
code 为证券标识；reliable 记录抽取冲突，source_locator、metric_value_raw、conflict_detail 提供核验依据。
